// diagnostic

E0357

An identifier is not written in the casing required for its grammatical category.

What

An identifier is not written in the casing required for its grammatical category.

Why

Jet enforces one two-tier law: type-like names use PascalCase; value-like names use snake_case.

Fix

rename the identifier to the exact spelling shown by the diagnostic. Foreign names inside FFI binding modules are exempt.

Worked example

First UI snapshot mentioning E0357: tests/ui/confusable_name.stderr.

Error [E0357]: local `I` must be snake_case
  --> tests/ui/confusable_name.jet:3:5
    |
  3 |     I :: 2
    |     ^
 Why: Jet uses one machine-enforced type-like/value-like casing law (D-SHAPE-CASE1)
 Fix: rename it to `i`
More: jet-lang.dev/e/E0357
